issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted, 2026-08-12) specifies a third dependency kind `verifies` so authors can declare a check relationship, plus a structural diagnosis of inverted verification gates (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead). No open bead covers it and the project is well past the 0.1 scope that deferred it, while the ADR measured 21 and 24 inverted edges in two live workspaces (4-6% of new beads). Work: extend the dependency schema/migrations and edge validation to accept `verifies` without changing cycle rejection; add the inversion diagnosis as an advisory report (never reject at insert time, never infer from issue titles); surface it in doctor/dependency reporting; round-trip the new kind through checkpoint import/export and document it in the field guide, `bead schema explain`, help, and the specs; add concurrency, round-trip, and legacy-two-kind-store tests.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
